internalNote: Built from Kevin's own per-song extraction CSV (union_harmony_final.csv), 143 songs, pages 17-142. Publication year deliberately left blank throughout (edition record, book-level facts, and here): the copyright/deposit page states the date as the "Twentieth day of April" in the "fifty-third year of the Independence of the United States of America," not a printed Gregorian year - per the extraction guide, this isn't converted into a year and asserted as printed evidence. The existing Work record's own firstEditionYear ("1829") appears to already be this same calculation from an earlier import; the Edition Code here (UnH1829) reuses that same year strictly as a practical identifier, not as a re-assertion that 1829 is a confirmed, printed fact - Kevin's own explicit choice, confirmed directly rather than assumed. The title page also names J. Robinson as printer; this is not folded into the publisher field, per Kevin's own instruction, and is recorded separately in the edition's own printer field instead. Five page numbers within the range (125, 130, 131, 139, 140) have no song entry - consistent with real pages with nothing to extract (illustration, blank, or advertisement pages), not a gap in the extraction. No index cross-check has been done against this book's own printed index yet - this is a first-pass build from the extraction CSV alone.
